title: Three-foot object with buttons lying on Mars

tellings.quote: that's 3 feet long and that big around that's and it's got buttons on it

plain: A man named Joe McMoneagle says that on Mars mapping negatives from NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory he saw an object lying on the ground about three feet long, and that "it's got buttons on it." He tells Michels he looked at the images himself, and offers it as a sign that something made by intelligent beings once existed on Mars.
